# Fix the slug truncation

Our report URLs use slugs truncated to a length limit, and the truncated slugs are
wrong: they can end with a dangling hyphen, like "my-report-". The
`truncate_slug(text, limit)` function in `repo/slug.py` should cut to at most `limit`
characters and strip any trailing hyphen, so "my-report-title" at 10 gives
"my-report". Please fix `truncate_slug`.

You can run the tests with: `python -m pytest tests/visible -q`

"""Slug helpers for report URLs."""


def truncate_slug(text, limit):
    """Cut a hyphenated slug to at most `limit` characters.

    The result must not end with a hyphen: truncating "my-report-title" at 10
    gives "my-report", not "my-report-".
    """
    # BUG: cuts at the limit but can leave a dangling trailing hyphen.
    return text[:limit]


def old_slugify(text):
    # TODO: legacy slug builder for the v1 report URLs. Remove after migration.
    return truncate_slug(text, 50)
test_slug.py
from repo.slug import truncate_slug


def test_strips_trailing_hyphen():
    assert truncate_slug("my-report-title", 10) == "my-report"


def test_short_unchanged():
    # PASS_TO_PASS: already under the limit and no trailing hyphen
    assert truncate_slug("abc", 10) == "abc"

content.text: Python and pytest both start fine, so I'll rerun the tests with a short wait to see where it stalls.

I fixed `truncate_slug`, and both tests in `tests/visible` pass. It now cuts the text to `limit` characters, then strips trailing hyphens, so "my-report-title" at 10 gives "my-report".

```4:10:repo/slug.py
def truncate_slug(text, limit):
    """Cut a hyphenated slug to at most `limit` characters.

    The result must not end with a hyphen: truncating "my-report-title" at 10
    gives "my-report", not "my-report-".
    """
    return text[:limit].rstrip("-")
```

This also removes runs of trailing hyphens, not just one: "a--b" at 3 gives "a". `old_slugify` calls `truncate_slug`, so the legacy v1 URLs get the fix too.

My first test run hung with no output, so I killed it. The same command then finished normally in under a second on two reruns, and I didn't find a cause.That error is from the first test run, the one that hung and that I killed myself. It isn't a new failure. The reruns after it passed both tests, so the fix to `truncate_slug` stands and nothing more is needed.
